title: American Revolutionary War begins at Lexington and Concord
summary: British troops marching to seize colonial weapons at Concord clashed with militiamen at Lexington and then at Concord's North Bridge, and were harried all the way back to Boston.
reason: Tension over British control of Massachusetts had reached a breaking point after the Intolerable Acts.
significance: These first shots began the war that created the United States.
